action_items: Minor: In PartnerApplicationPage hero title, 'Proponi una collaborazione.' renders as 'Proponi unacollaborazione.' — check CMS locale_content for hero_editorial and whether the title split logic handles newlines correctly (line.split('\n') maps to <span> without spaces)
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: StorySectionsEditor.jsx - safeBlocks useMemo had dependency [blocks.length, blocks.map(b => b.id).join('|')] which doesn't track content changes. YouTube video_id was never visible in BlockRow after URL entry because memo returned stale blocks. Fixed by using [blocks] as memo dep.

StorySectionsEditor addBlock switch statement has no 'youtube' case — falls through to default: {type, text:''}. Should have youtube case with {type, url:'', video_id:'', title:''}. Not blocking since onChange correctly sets url+video_id on input, but initial block shape is inconsistent.

youtube_preview_bug.root_cause: StorySectionsEditor useMemo for safeBlocks had deps [blocks.length, blocks.map(b => b.id).join('|')]. When user types URL, block content (url, video_id) changes but ID and length stay same, so memo returned stale blocks without video_id. BlockRow received stale block, preview condition {block.video_id && ...} was false.
youtube_preview_bug.fix: Changed memo dep to [blocks] so it recomputes whenever the blocks array reference changes (which happens on every block content update from parent state).
